testMethod: Actual XPI in an isolated Zotero profile. A Cooltools fixture with a Europe PMC collectiveName verifies Open2C in the first position in preview and in Zotero single-field creator storage. Repeat lookup omitting the collective verifies that the saved authors are retained by default. Core tests distinguish a missing collective from a genuinely conflicting first author. The prior batch page and repeated lookup tests also passed.
